tool.name: Perseus Filter Kraken2 Output
tool.description: score and filter Kraken2 classifications using extracted Perseus features
tool.command:
#set $taxonomy_db_path = $taxonomy_db.fields.path
## `perseus filter` has no --threads option, but its Torch forward pass honours ## the OpenMP/MKL thread counts, so keep it inside the slots Galaxy allocated. export OMP_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && export MKL_NUM_THREADS="\${GALAXY_SLOTS:-1}" && mkdir -p taxonomy_db && ln -s '$taxonomy_db_path' taxonomy_db/taxa.sqlite && mkdir -p feature_shards && tar -xf '$feature_shards' -C feature_shards && perseus filter feature_shards '$kraken_input' perseus_filter_output.tsv taxonomy_db --seed $seed #if $output_all: --output-all #end if && #if $output_all: mv perseus_filter_output.tsv '$filtered_output' && mv 'perseus_filter_output.full.tsv' '$all_assignments' #else: mv perseus_filter_output.tsv '$filtered_output' #end if

param.name: feature_shards
param.label: Feature shards
param.help: The tar archive produced by the Perseus Extract Features tool

param.label: Output all candidate assignments
param.help: Report every candidate taxonomic assignment per sequence instead of only the single most likely one

tool.help:
**What it does**
Scores each Kraken2 classification with a trained convolutional neural network and combines the model output with lineage information in the installed Perseus taxonomy database to assign a confidence probability at every canonical taxonomic rank (superkingdom, phylum, class, order, family, genus, species).
The output is similar to the input Kraken2 output file, but without the string of k-mer matches, and with the following additional columns:
- ``perseus_taxid`` - the taxonomic ID assigned by Perseus - ``perseus_taxonomy`` - the taxonomic name assigned by Perseus - ``chosen_rank`` - the final chosen rank assigned by Perseus - ``chosen_prob_at_rank`` - the probability at the final chosen rank - ``prob_{rank}`` - the assignment probability at each canonical rank
-----
**Inputs**
- **Feature shards**: the tar archive produced by the `Perseus Extract Features` tool. - **Kraken2 output file**: the same per-read classification file used for feature extraction. - **ETE3 taxonomy database**: an NCBI/ETE3 taxonomy database installed by the ETE3 Taxonomy Database Data Manager.
-----
**About Perseus**
Perseus is a post-processing framework for refining Kraken2 taxonomic classifications, with a focus on long-read metagenomics (PacBio HiFi, ONT). It is designed to reduce false positive fine-rank calls arising from conserved regions, sparse k-mer support, and reference database incompleteness, by backing off low-confidence assignments to higher, lineage-consistent ranks.
